category.name: Image editing
category.description: Raster image retouching, compositing and digital painting, plus RAW photo development and library workflows.
category.audience: Photographers, designers, illustrators and people preparing images for work or personal projects.
category.audienceRationale: Image preparation spans creative professions and occasional general use; RAW development and digital painting are more specialized workflows within the category.

pricing.note: Lowest listed individual plan including desktop Photoshop is Photography at US$19.99/month on an annual commitment billed monthly; standalone Photoshop US$22.99/month. Web/mobile-only offer excluded from desktop comparison.
Individual Lightroom plan US$11.99/month, annual commitment billed monthly; includes mobile, desktop, web and Lightroom Classic.

oss.name: GIMP
oss.classificationReason: Locally operated desktop image editor. All published application functionality available as free software; no commercial feature edition identified. Core GPL v3 or later; libgimp libraries LGPL, icons CC BY-SA, data licensing has historical caveats in LICENSE. GitHub is an active read-only GNOME GitLab mirror.

health.rsx: Shared rsx analyze overall 4.2/10; GitHub mirror omits canonical issue/PR/release activity, so low activity signals are not canonical inactivity.

oss.name: darktable
oss.classificationReason: Locally operated desktop RAW developer and photo library application. Published workflow functionality available in the GPL edition; official source and installers available without a paid edition. Community Flatpak omits AI features: packaging limitation, not a paid software gate.

health.rsx: Shared rsx analyze overall 6.7/10; GitHub activity and current release captured; root GPL text and official licensing statement override unknown license scoring.

oss.name: Krita
oss.classificationReason: Locally operated desktop digital painting application. GPL v3 application with some more permissively licensed parts. Free installers/source and paid store distribution; store income funds development and automatic updates, no separate paid feature edition identified. Canonical development on KDE Invent; active GitHub mirror.

health.rsx: Shared rsx analyze overall 4.9/10; GitHub mirror omits canonical issue/PR/release activity, so low activity signals are not canonical inactivity.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Local retouching and compositing alternative. Workflow/UI differ; save editable projects as XCF and export interchange copies, since non-native formats lose some project information. RAW development uses darktable or RawTherapee plug-ins. Validate required project features before switching.

Best fit for digital painting and illustration done in Photoshop. Krita emphasizes painting rather than the full image-manipulation workflow. Supports PSD layers and masks but does not promise complete compatibility; official manual recommends ORA or TIFF interchange when possible.

Local RAW development and photo-library workflow. Official FAQ warns this is not a direct replacement: presets are incompatible, Lightroom edit import is old and unreliable, and edits may need rebuilding. Check camera support; do not assume Adobe cloud/library synchronization transfers.

uncertainties: No first-party hosted image editing service identified for these desktop projects; false hostedOffer reflects reviewed official offerings.
GIMP and Krita GitHub latest-release APIs return 404; official website releases recorded instead. GitHub metadata and rsx assess active mirrors, not canonical issue/merge-request systems.
No complete Adobe project, preset, plugin or cloud-service migration is claimed; only supported workflow edges included.
